summary: Sony and NanaOn-Sha's paper-cutout rhythm-game series, including PaRappa's original rap game, the Um Jammer Lammy guitar spin-off, and the PS2 sequel.

entries.title: PaRappa the Rapper

emulation.emulator: Native PS4/PS5 backward compatibility; PPSSPP for PSP extras
emulation.notes: Use PS4 remaster for the main run and PPSSPP/PSP only for extra-mode documentation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS4 remaster output up to PS4 Pro 4K support.

primary.why: The PS4 remaster is the highest-fidelity official route, with HD remastering, 4K support on PS4 Pro, enhanced audio, and accessibility beat features.
primary.how_to_play: Play PaRappa the Rapper Remastered on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Use the PSP version only for its portable multiplayer/remix features.

secondary.exclusive_content: Ad hoc multiplayer for up to four players and downloadable remixed song versions in the PSP port.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the PSP port's multiplayer/remix extras if preserved and accessible.
secondary.why: The PSP version has ad hoc multiplayer and downloadable remixes.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically first, but lower-fidelity than the PS4 remaster.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable port with PSP-specific multiplayer/remix features.
all_releases.reason: secondary: not the best fidelity, but has PSP-specific extra functionality.

all_releases.fidelity: HD remaster with 4K support on PS4 Pro, enhanced audio, and beat-assist features.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PS4 Remastered is best fidelity; PSP has multiplayer/remix extras worth a secondary check.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remaster preserves the original game but adds HD/audio/accessibility enhancements; PSP extras are separate.

emulation.emulator: DuckStation; MAME for arcade NOW! if preserved/compatible
emulation.notes: Use PlayStation for main play. Arcade version depends on cabinet/emulation preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Upscaled PS1 output; arcade output for NOW! comparison.

primary.why: The PlayStation release is the complete home version with Lammy's campaign, multiplayer, and PaRappa side-story content; DuckStation gives the cleanest capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation release through DuckStation with internal resolution upscaling. Treat Um Jammer Lammy NOW! as a secondary arcade curiosity for its guitar-controller presentation and unique arcade material.

secondary.exclusive_content: Um Jammer Lammy NOW! uses a unique guitar controller, has unique attract-mode cutscenes/music video material, arcade difficulty tiers, and lets Stage 1 be played as PaRappa.
secondary.what_to_play: Document the arcade controller/presentation and the unique PaRappa/attract-mode differences.
secondary.why: The arcade version has a guitar controller, unique attract material, difficulty tiers, and a PaRappa Stage 1 difference.

all_releases.reason: primary: complete home version and best practical main route.

all_releases.fidelity: Namco System 12 arcade version with guitar controller.
all_releases.reason: secondary: unique arcade controller/presentation and differences, but not the main home playthrough route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PlayStation is the complete home version; arcade NOW! has unique controller/presentation material worth secondary documentation.

entries.title: PaRappa the Rapper 2

emulation.emulator: Native PS4/PS5 backward compatibility; PCSX2 for PS2 original
emulation.notes: Use PS4 release for main capture.

primary.why: The PS4 digital release provides 1080p up-rendering, trophies, and modern PlayStation capture while preserving the PS2 game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 digital release, or on PS5 backward compatibility if available. Use PCSX2/PS2 only for original-release comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but PS4 up-rendered release is cleaner for capture.

all_releases.fidelity: PS2-on-PS4 release with 1080p up-rendering and trophies.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS4 release is the best official route and has no known missing gameplay content.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an up-rendered PS2 Classics style release rather than a full remake.
